## Remarks

RAM cost: 0 GB

Attempts to get the expected answer of a conding contract. Throws an exception for some contract types. Converts the contract into a dummy contract with no reward (like the contracts generated by [createDummyContract](./bitburner.codingcontract.createdummycontract.md)<!-- -->).
